text:
alex: Heads-up — I'm seeing a mismatch between the Python/TS SDKs and the REST behavior on /v1/generate for the optional `format` enum. SDKs send/expect strings but the service started emitting numeric enums in responses.

priya: Can you paste a minimal repro (curl vs SDK payload)? which route/version?

alex: Repro here:
```bash
# curl (service returns numeric enum)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"prompt":"hi","format":0}'

# python sdk (what SDK sends)
client.generate(prompt="hi", format="text")
# serialized JSON -> {"prompt":"hi","format":"text"}
```

mason: I pushed a serializer change to shrink payloads earlier this week — switched enum JSON encoding to the numeric value to save bytes for high-volume customers. Server accepts both for inputs but I mistakenly switched responses to numeric only. That explains it.

tyler: Did this surface as a regression in prod or just during tests?

alex: Hit one enterprise integration E2E — their TS client runtime validation throws `Unknown enum value 0`. Small number of errors but reproducible.

priya: I'll open an SDK patch to accept numeric enums on parse and to normalize to string on send. Also add a runtime guard in TS. PR incoming. @mason can backend keep responses tolerant (map numeric->string) until SDKs ship?

mason: Yes, can add a parsing fallback tomorrow morning. I can roll a hotfix to map numbers to strings in response layer.

ci-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4567 by priya — CI queued.

tyler: Nice. Assign reviews: @alex can you review the SDK patch? I'll coordinate backend deploy.

alex: Will review the PR later today. Quick checklist from my side: unit tests for both numeric and string enum variants, integration test against staging, and a changelog note.

priya: Plan: (1) SDK: accept numeric + send string, add tests, bump patch release; (2) Backend: add response fallback mapping numeric->string for one week; (3) Devex: add integration test to catch this. ETA: EOD for SDK branch, backend hotfix in morning.

mason: Sounds good. I'll post deploy window once hotfix is ready.

alex: Thanks all :thumbsup:

priya: PR link again: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4567 — putting a code comment about the enum switch and linking this thread.

tyler: Marking this high-priority for the next patch release.
